_note: Files under src/ (non-test) containing an LLM provider transport call. A NEW file here must be mapped (to a manifest assembler, or to a kind with a reason) before merge; `unclassified_census_gap` is closed and must stay empty. Edits inside listed files do not trip the ratchet.

src/cee/decision-review/invoke.ts.reason: Serialises the review request from the licensed Run facts (context/licensed-run-facts.ts) the enricher builds; guarded by decision-review-licensed-reads.guard.test.ts.

src/cee/draft-quality/judge.ts.reason: Draft-time quality judge over the draft graph and brief; carries no Run facts.

src/cee/dual-draft/m2-review.ts.reason: Draft-time review over the draft graph and brief; carries no Run facts.

src/cee/unified-pipeline/stages/coaching.reason: Draft-pipeline coaching stage over the draft graph and brief; carries no Run facts.

src/cee/validation-pipeline/validate-gra.reason: Graph validation over the draft graph only.

src/orchestrator-v5/agent-lane/runtime/b.reason: Construction: the user's brief and a compact graph; no Run facts.

src/orchestrator/tools/edit-graph.ts.reason: V2 edit tool builds its own context; on staging it ran about once in 24 h (10 Oct), not on the served path.

src/orchestrator-v5/agent-lane/runtime/w.reason: Widening pass over the admitted draft: signals come from assembleGuidanceSignals (turn-context/guidance-signals.ts) and the candidate model; carries no Run facts.

src/orchestrator-v5/routing/open-frame-i.reason: Advisory start_model/continue_conversation call on an EMPTY model: the current message and at most OPEN_FRAME_INTAKE_RECENT_TURNS_CAP recent turns; no graph, analysis or figure.

src/orchestrator-v5/replacement/agent-lo.reason: The model call is injected; the input is the replacement layer's projectTurnContext / read tools.

src/orchestrator-v5/routing/route-with-t.reason: The V5 router's input is the ContextPack built by the canonical assembler, serialised by buildUserMessage.

src/routes/agent-v1-turn.ts.reason: The Agent loop input is projectModelContext + withSavedRunCertainty; the Run interpreter input is assembled inline from the licensed pieces (canonicalAfterRun / selectedRun), pinned by run-explanation-one-assembly.test.ts.

src/routes/assist.v1.decision-review.ts.reason: Standalone API: request-validated input with no Run; calls buildDecisionReviewUserMessage without licensed facts (the single exemption in decision-review-licensed-reads.guard.test.ts).
